meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后,当你要修 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的缺陷时,Claude 会在临时工作区里调试、写最小修复并验证,然后交付:对 LazyCodex 仓库发带补丁的 issue,对 openai/codex 发 fork PR。
howto.when: 当你说“修复 bug”“贡献修复”“给 bug 开 PR”等,或要求调试并提交 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷修复时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试并修复 LazyCodex 的这个缺陷。
为 openai/codex 的这个 bug 开一个 fork PR。
say.note: Claude 会走复现、测试、修复,并创建 PR。

say.text: 调试 omo-codex 的这个问题,提交修复。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you want to fix a LazyCodex or Codex defect, Claude debugs in a fresh temporary workspace, implements the smallest fix, verifies it, and delivers: a verified-fix issue with embedded patch for code-yeongyu/lazycodex, or a fork PR for openai/codex.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, or open a PR for a bug, or debug and submit a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Debug and fix this defect in LazyCodex for me.
say_en.note: Claude reproduces, fixes, and creates a verified-fix issue on lazycodex repo.

say_en.text: Open a fork PR for this bug in openai/codex.
say_en.note: Claude reproduces, tests, fixes, and creates the PR.

say_en.text: Debug this omo-codex issue and submit a fix.
say_en.note: Depending on ownership, Claude creates a verified-fix issue.
